|game_text=Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. If a battle was just initiated against your lone [[Tusken Raider]], may 'react' by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or [[Bantha (V){{!}}Bantha]](s) here. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Bantha Herd (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. If a battle was just initiated against your lone Tusken Raider, may ‘react’ by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Bantha Herd (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bantha Herd (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “If a battle was just initiated against your lone Tusken Raider, may ‘react’ by deploying” to “You may 'react' to battles initiated against your lone Tusken Raider by deploying” and writes the [Immune to Alter] icon out as “(Immune to Alter.)”: “Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. You may 'react' to battles initiated against your lone Tusken Raider by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1230_24-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
